$comment: Release channels for this library. Consumed by snackbyte-release-flow-action (jeff-fichtner/snackbyte-release-flow-action@v1) under version-strategy: package-json. The flow reads `branch` (is this a release channel? which one?) and `tagSuffix` (stamped on the derived tag). For a published library the version itself comes from package.json, not from a build counter. Adding a channel (e.g. a `next` pre-release lane) is a one-row edit here plus its branch.
